## Authorisation

<!-- Owner decision/delegation, scope and evidence. Separate new business decisions from implementation choices. Merge requires explicit owner authorisation. -->

## Record

<!-- Local requirement IDs, business/technical ADRs, merged record PR and spec. For imported material, preserve source commit/provenance. State conflicts or unanswered questions. "None" for a purely technical change. -->

## Contract

<!-- OpenAPI/error-code impact, compatibility or explicit breaking version, affected callers and migration/rollback. Link the direct web request and publication commit when relevant. Web pins an API commit and tests integration; state adoption as unconfirmed until web confirms its pin/result. Otherwise: "no change". -->

## Cross-repo work

<!-- Linked API/web issues, requested behaviour/contract needs, receiving repo ownership, actual blockers and independent work. Necessary task-related requests/replies are owner-authorised; requests do not approve business rules. No context coordinator or sibling edits. "None" if not needed. -->

## Validation

<!-- Checks actually run and results: build, fast tests, vet, gofmt, generation, docs links; slow tests are CI's per testing policy. Rule-derived tests and mutation proof for product changes; provenance/workflow checks for docs-only changes. -->

## Review

<!-- `code-review` findings: fixed, or listed here with the reason they stay. -->

## Migration and remaining work

<!-- Forward migration, rollback, source provenance, external dependencies and unresolved questions. State any excluded scope or pending evidence. "None" only when none apply. -->
